mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% (UNRATE) indicates economic distress and weak consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%, or correlation coefficient between UNRATE > 8.0 and negative returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages, or interaction term coefficient is negative in regression model.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO > 100 and increasing) indicates manufacturing expansion, supporting corporate profit growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is above 100 and rising, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPI reading above 230.0 (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation, triggering Federal Reserve rate hikes that depress equity valuations and cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 230.0, or correlation between CPIAUCSL > 230.0 and negative returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Higher total employment (PAYEMS) reflects labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC for PAYEMS level < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95.0 (INDPRO) indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 95.0, or correlation between INDPRO < 95.0 and negative returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales exceeding 400,000 (RSAFS) signals strong consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 400,000, or Rank IC for RSAFS level < 0.03.
